 under Sections 498A/406/323/376D/506/34 of the Ipc and

 1.
Notice is placed on record.
Inspite of service of notice, nobody appears for the victim.
2. Petitioner is the husband of the victim lady.
It is alleged she had lodged an earlier case on false allegations against the husband.
He prays for anticipatory bail.
3. Learned lawyer for State opposes the prayer.
4. We have considered the materials on record including the statement of the victim.
It is contended the victim had lodged an earlier case against the petitioner and her in-laws.

In the present case, she Sections 3/4 Of Dowry Prohibition Act; vs In Re: Md. Kalamuddin @ Kalamuddin on 5 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193150632/
1 alleged she was assaulted and raped by her in-law and another.
Allegation of rape is not levelled against the petitioner.
5. Whether allegation of rape is an embellishment in the light of prior enmity between the parties may be assessed at the appropriate stage of the proceeding.
Be that as it may, such allegation has not been levelled against her husband.
Under such circumstances, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail.

6. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner viz., Md. Kalamuddin @
Kalamuddin be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
He shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date.
7. The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, disposed of.

(Subhendu Samanta, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
